frames.prompt: Premium food commercial still, photographed for real, not illustrated. Macro view into a domed clay tannur oven: a round flatbread puffing up against the glowing inner wall, its surface blistering with dark char spots, embers glowing orange below, heat shimmer and a wisp of smoke. The fire is the only light: hard, warm, raking across the bread's texture. Background falls to pure black. 100 mm macro lens at f/2.8, very shallow depth of field, shot on an ARRI Alexa 35, true-to-life colour, deep blacks, crisp detail, subtle film grain. No people, no hands, no text, no letters, no logos.

Documentary photograph on 35 mm film, candid and unposed: before dawn in a small family bakery kitchen, a baker in her fifties wearing a navy headscarf, a long-sleeved dark top and a flour-dusted canvas apron presses a round of dough onto the inner wall of a glowing clay tannur oven.
